name: great_sling_gs2
title: The great sling, concept round GS2 (D-127): siege-weight traction sling, every family's take
_doc: Dominic on GS1: 'pretty cool, but needs to be bigger and more robust looking, for siege! not thin and skinny.' A heavy squared-timber frame on sills, a thick banded arm, a big sling and a stone pile, six haulers and a loader (D-118). Size references: a worker, the catapult, GS1's sling. Models: scenes/art_pixel/m13_concepts.gd (GS2), staged from data/later/m13_concepts.json. Notes: docs/concepts/great_sling/README.md.
